name: Luca
source: A half-human and half-dark elf, a member of Direc's order. She was bought by Direc when she was a child. She has been trained not only as a swordswoman but also as a woman, and thus she is capable of serving as a first-class prostitute. She is happy to serve Direk who showed her the way and she is willing to do any dirty work for him.
